title: feat(spec,rest,cli): a doc book's title and section titles are translatable — `books.<name>` in the translation bundle
body:
_Requested by **Yibo Wang** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB?thread=cmsg_01BVUyyPie8gHwoPM18iABwB9f5JerDTtsejdoL5dyVSwJ)_ Fixes #26690 Clause-②: yes (widening) Metadata-protocol: added Skills-docs: #26820. The docs are updated here. ## 维护者速读 - **改了什么：** 翻译包新增 `books` 分组，书名、书的描述和每个分组标题（按分组 `key`）都能翻译；`GET /meta/book`（列表和单项）和 `GET /meta/book/:name/tree` 按请求语言返回，控制台 `/apps/<包>/docs` 侧栏随之显示译文。`os i18n extract` 会生成这些键，`os i18n check` 报缺失为 `i18n/missing-book`。 - **为什么改：** 文档正文能按语言出，但书名和侧栏分组名只能写一种语言，中文用户看到半中半英的手册（HotCRM 使用手册）。 - **风险与回滚：** 只加不删：英文读者拿到的是原样字符串（同一引用）；书的 `translations` 内联写法仍被拒绝，只是提示改为指向新键。回滚即还原本 PR。 - **先看：** `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts`（`translateBook`）、`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`（树接口翻译这一步）、`packages/spec/src/system/translation.zod.ts`（`books` 分组形状）。 - **两分钟验证：** `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts -t 26690`，预期 zh-CN 拿到「帮助中心 / 开始」，en-US 拿到「Help Centre / Start」，两个传输层一致。 - **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。 ## What changes One translation path for a doc book's spine — the translation bundle, the same path an app's label and navigation labels take. No inline locale map comes back on the book (the retired 17.0.0 map stays a tombstone; sibling groups such as `apps..navigation..label` and `pages..label` use the bundle, not inline maps). - **`@objectstack/spec` — `system/translation.zod.ts`:** a `books` group on the shared per-app shape, so the bundle entry (`TranslationData`), the registered `translation` item and the platform bundle all accept it. Keyed by the book `name`: `label`, `description`, and `groups.GROUP_KEY.label` (by the group's stable `key`, as a navigation node is keyed by its `id`). Strict at every level; `name` / `title` point at `label`, `sections` / `chapters` / `toc` point at `groups`, the singular `book` points at `books`. The group counts in the `settings` refusal prose and the shape docblocks move fourteen → fifteen (and fifteen → sixteen for the platform face). - **`@objectstack/spec` — `system/i18n-resolver.ts`:** `translateBook`, registered in `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS`. `TRANSLATABLE_METADATA_TYPES` is derived from that table and `@objectstack/rest` reads it, so `GET /meta/book` (list and item, both transports) is served in the request locale with no further wiring. A key the bundle does not carry keeps the authored string; a document with nothing to translate comes back as the same reference. - **`@objectstack/spec` — `system/book.zod.ts`:** the retired inline-`translations` prescription now names the bundle keys to move the strings to (it used to say the tree and portal render verbatim, which this PR makes untrue). Book `label` and group `label` describes name their bundle keys. - **`@objectstack/rest` — `createMetaBookTreeAnswer`:** step 5 translates the resolved book through `translateMetaDocument` (the same table) before rendering the spine, so the tree and the list the sidebar is built from agree. Translated after the §6.7 audience gate; a label is not an access input. `MetaBookTreeSources` gains `resolveI18nService()`; `RestServer`'s route supplies it. - **`@objectstack/runtime` — dispatcher book-tree route:** spreads `metaTranslationSources`, so it answers the localized tree `RestServer` answers. - **`@objectstack/cli`:** `walkBooks` in `os i18n extract` emits `books.NAME.label` / `.description` (`pushOptional`) and `books.NAME.groups.KEY.label` (`pushEntry`, the label is required); coverage reports a gap as `i18n/missing-book`. - **Liveness:** `translation/books` seeded `live` with its reader, drilled to `label`, `description`, `groups` and `groups.label`. - **Console sidebar:** no code change. The docs portal builds its sidebar from `GET /meta/book` (`use-book-data.ts`), the client sends `Accept-Language` on every request, and the console already remounts the metadata subtree on a language switch. A console test pins the chain. - **`examples/app-showcase`:** zh-CN strings for `showcase_manual` (title, description, three section titles), so the new walk does not grow `check:i18n-coverage`. - **Docs:** `ui/doc-pages.mdx` gains a "Translating the spine" section (the inline-map callout now points at it); `ui/translations.mdx` and `protocol/kernel/i18n-standard.mdx` list the new group. - **`@objectstack/lint` — `translation-target-unknown`:** resolves `books.NAME` against the declared books (a sibling package's included) and the implicit per-package book (the package id, its one `all` group read off `deriveImplicitPackageBook`), and `books.NAME.groups.KEY` against that book's group keys. A mistyped book name or group key is an `error` with the nearest declared name. The rule's header and its `explainRule` paragraph cover the new arm. - **`@object-ui/i18n` — `SPEC_TRANSLATION_GROUPS`:** gains `books`, so the console's language loader walks the served group (the existing `loadLanguage` pin requires it). The Studio translation-preview coverage pin moves to `2/15 (13%)` with the `books` category key. ## Why A package that ships its docs in two languages showed a half-translated manual. Each doc's body already followed the reader's locale (`doc.translations`, `NAME.LOCALE.md`), but the book title and every sidebar section title stayed in the authoring language: the book's inline `translations` map was retired in 17.0.0 because nothing read it, and the translation bundle had no key for a book. This gives the spine a translation slot on the one path navigation items and pages already use. ## Tests - `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-book.test.ts` (new, 11): the three doors accept `books`; the face is closed; the aliases; the tombstone names the new keys; a zh-CN reader gets title, description and every section title; the translated book renders a translated spine through `resolveBookTree`; an en-US reader gets the same reference; per-key fallback; BCP-47 ladder and fallback chain; no mutation. - `packages/cli/test/i18n-book-walk.test.ts` (new, 4): the walk, seeding, a bundle written at the extracted paths parses, and the `book` coverage bucket. - `packages/runtime/src/domains/meta-list-projection-parity.test.ts`: the census fixture bundle gains a `books` entry, so every list, item and tree cell compares both transports under `Accept-Language: zh-CN` / `?locale=zh-CN` as well. New reference pins: the zh-CN book list (and en-US unchanged), the zh-CN book item, and the tree on BOTH transports — zh-CN title and section title, en-US authored, the doc entry still localized by `doc.translations`. - `ui/apps/console/src/pages/docs-portal.bookLocale-26690.test.tsx` (new, 2): the real `/apps/:appName/docs` routes, layout, reader and sidebar over an adapter that answers `GET /meta/book` by running the authored book through the spec's translator with a bundle (bundle → served book → sidebar): zh-CN shows the translated title (`aria-label`) and section titles; en-US is unchanged. - `packages/lint/src/validate-translation-references.test.ts` (5 new): a declared book and its group keys are clean; an unknown book name; unknown group keys, a group label among them; a sibling package's book; the implicit per-package book and an orphan group under it. Removing the `books` loop reds three of them. ## Acceptance notes - **`MetaBookTreeSources.resolveI18nService` is a required member.** Both in-repo transports supply it. A third-party implementer of this exported port would need to add it; making it optional would let a transport silently serve untranslated labels. Flagged for the contract review: the seat may prefer it optional. - **The synthetic *Uncategorized* group stays English.** `resolveBookTree` hardcodes its label; it is not an authored group and has no bundle key. Pre-existing, unchanged by this PR. - **The implicit per-package book** (no authored book; name = package id) also resolves `books.PACKAGE_ID.label` if a bundle carries it — an effect of translating whatever book the tree resolves, not a declared feature. - **`translation-target-unknown` resolves `books.NAME` and `books.NAME.groups.KEY`** against the declared books (a sibling package's included) and the implicit per-package book (the package id, one `all` group read off `deriveImplicitPackageBook`): a mistyped book name or group key is an `error` with the nearest declared name. Added in the review's patch round (claim amendment 6449487635). - No `!` in the title and no `(narrowing)` arm, so no full dogfood run is owed. ## Verification Head `1f17d1834` for the suites below. The patch round at `4b8fb9a1b` (the `books` lint arm and the two UI fixes) re-ran: `@objectstack/lint` test 7435 passed, typecheck exit 0; the UI `loadLanguage`, `@object-ui/i18n` and app-shell preview suites, 235 files passed; `check:generated` exit 0; the 31 lint, changeset, i18n and UI gate families from `dispatch-gates`, every exit 0 (the derived set is still 123). Every build and test ran through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` on a shared box.
Build and package suites - `pnpm build`: 116/116 tasks, exit 0 (the first run found the Studio translation preview's exhaustive group table missing `books`; fixed in this PR). - `@objectstack/spec` test: 735 files, 22021 passed; typecheck exit 0. - `@objectstack/rest` test: 6498 passed; typecheck exit 0. - `@objectstack/runtime` test: 7448 passed; typecheck exit 0. - `@objectstack/cli` unit: 4938 passed; typecheck exit 0. - UI: `vitest run` of the console book-locale test and the Studio translation-preview test: 2 files, 23 passed. `type-check` of `@object-ui/app-shell` and `@object-ui/console`: exit 0. - `eslint` over the 16 touched TS/TSX files: 0 errors, 0 warnings.
Ablations (each red, then restored; git diff HEAD empty) - Drop `book: translateBook` from `METADATA_DOCUMENT_TRANSLATORS`: `i18n-book.test.ts` 2 of 11 fail; 3 runtime parity tests fail (list, item, tree). - Replace the tree's translate step with the untranslated book: the tree test fails on both transports. - Drop `walkBooks(config, out)`: `i18n-book-walk.test.ts` 4 of 4 fail. - Console test, adapter returns the authored book instead of the translated one: the zh-CN sidebar test fails. (The console test reads the built spec, so a source-only ablation of the translator does not reach it; the chain it pins is served book → sidebar.)
Derived gates - `dispatch-gates --commands`: 123 commands; `dispatch-gates --ran`: 123 derived, 123 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN; every exit 0. The three build-output gates (`check:skill-examples`, `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`, `check:i18n-coverage`) and `check:test-source-alias`, `check:i18n`, `check:i18n-walk-parity` were re-run after the full build. - The 12 artifact-roster gates whose roster sits in a touched directory (`check-published-list-mirrors`, `check:meta-url-spelling`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:changeset-fixed`, `check:engine-double-contract`, `check:error-code-casing`, `check:filter-alias-parity`, `check:i18n-stale-fill`, `check:published-readme-exports`, `check:route-ledger-census`, `check-dts-references`, `check:stack-collection-maps`): all exit 0. - `check:generated` exit 0; `check:liveness` exit 0 (translation state counts 38 → 41).
## Human Minimum - [x] 1. Schemas start as Zod; `packages/spec` holds no runtime logic. (`translateBook` joins the existing translators in `system/i18n-resolver.ts`, the table the readers already dispatch through.) - [x] 2. Every name I added uses the casing for its kind. - [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (eslint over the touched files, above). - [x] 4. One issue, one branch off an up-to-date `main`, one pull request. - [x] 5. A change that publishes carries a changeset, and both declaration lines are filled in here and in the changeset. - [x] 6. `packages/spec` touched: its generated artifacts are regenerated and committed. - [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`. - [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (apart from the maintainer quick-read block, which the dispatch procedure writes in Chinese). - [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done. --- _Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_01WGufzf4dTFmjsttVz7Pm8j)_ 🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code) https://claude.ai/code/session_01WGufzf4dTFmjsttVz7Pm8j
